name: Phila Hubbard
source:
The near-identical twin sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c174172]Mina[/url]. Compared to her sister, she's a lot more stern and irritable, and is often seen by others as bossy. She's very protective of her sister and the two are never seen apart when they can help it, which some people think is a little odd. She enjoys playing video games while Mina watches.

[In game description]
